note: Ps76 Zion victory-hymn (Asaph). God's own acts = qualifiers (broke arrows/sword/war; rebuke; uttered judgment; arose to save; cuts off spirit of princes; is to-be-feared x3). Human IB: earth FEARED + was STILL before judgment (v8); the HUMBLE God saves (v9); man's WRATH that shall PRAISE him (v10); making/PERFORMING VOWS + BRINGING homage (v11); the SPIRIT of princes God humbles (v12). War/weapon/spoil imagery + dwelling + directions = standalone.

dims.v: fear / be in awe (yare - the earth feared)
God, who uttered judgment from heaven

'From the heavens you uttered judgment; the earth FEARED (yare) and was still' - the awe of the whole earth before God's verdict; yare here the creaturely dread that answers the divine sentence, a fear that quiets all
be still / quiet (shaqat - and was still)

'the earth feared and was STILL (shaqat)' - the hush that follows the divine verdict; shaqat here the silence of awe, the earth stilled when God rises to judge - dread expressed not as clamour but as quiet
humble / afflicted (anav - all the humble of the earth)
the humble / oppressed of the earth
the object of God's saving judgment

'when God arose to judgment, to save all the HUMBLE (anav) of the earth' - the afflicted, the lowly oppressed; anav here the meek whose vindication is the very aim of God's rising - the humble are saved where the proud princes are cut off (v12)
wrath / fury (chemah - the wrath of man)
even hostile rage made to serve God's glory
paired with the praise it is made to render

'Surely the WRATH (chemah) of man shall praise you' - human fury, even in its rebellion, God turns to his own honour; chemah here the hot anger of men that, overruled, becomes an instrument of praise - the residue God restrains (the remnant of wrath, v10b)
praise / give thanks (yadah - shall praise you)
the wrath of man made to render it

'the wrath of man shall PRAISE (yadah) you' - even human fury is bent to God's glory; yadah here praise wrung from rebellion itself, the paradox that God's sovereignty turns the anger of men into acknowledgement of him
vows (neder - make your vows to the LORD)

'Make your VOWS (neder) to the LORD your God and perform them' - the devotion the fearsome God calls forth; neder here the solemn pledge of the worshipper, the vowed self-binding that the awe of God (v11b) evokes
the vows made to the LORD
paired with the making of vows
'and PERFORM (shalam) them' - the completing of the vow, not merely its making; shalam here the paying of what was pledged, devotion proved by fulfilment before the God who is to be feared
bring / present (yabal - let all bring gifts)
to him who is to be feared
paired with the vows and their performance

'let all around him BRING (yabal) gifts to him who is to be feared' - the homage the surrounding peoples render; yabal here the ceremonial bringing of tribute, the outward act of reverence toward the awesome God
spirit / breath (ruach - he cuts off the spirit of princes)
set against the humble who are saved (v9)

'he cuts off the SPIRIT (ruach) of princes' - the proud life-breath, the haughty animating temper of rulers; ruach here the spirit of the mighty that God curbs and severs, the arrogance of power brought low before the God feared by kings
be known / renowned (yada - in Judah God is known)
God's renown, ground of the worship this psalm renders
v1 QUALIFIER (God's renown): 'In Judah God is KNOWN (yada)' - God's being-known/famed is not a human IB char; his self-revealed renown among his people. Qualifier.
name (shem - his name is great in Israel)
the greatness of God's name, ground of the praise
v1 QUALIFIER (God's name): 'his NAME (shem) is great in Israel' - God's great name is not a human IB char; his renown in Israel. Qualifier.
break / shatter (shabar - there he broke the flashing arrows)
God's shattering of war, ground of the awe he inspires

v3 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'There he BROKE (shabar) the flashing arrows, the shield, the sword' - God's shattering of weapons is not a human IB char; his victory that makes the earth fear (v8). Qualifier.
God's rebuke, which stuns the enemy and grounds the earth's fear
v6 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'At your REBUKE (gaarah), O God of Jacob, both rider and horse lay stunned' - God's rebuke is not a human IB char; his word that fells the war-host. Qualifier.
to be feared / awesome (yare niphal - you are to be feared)
God's fearsomeness, which draws forth the earth's fear (v8)

v7 QUALIFIER (God's attribute): 'You, you are to be FEARED (nora)!' - God's own awesomeness is not a human IB char; the terror of his presence to which the human fear/stillness (v8) responds. Qualifier.
anger (aph - when once your anger is roused)
God's roused anger, before which none can stand
v7 QUALIFIER (God's wrath): 'who can stand before you when once your ANGER (aph) is roused?' - God's anger is not a human IB char; the divine wrath that none withstand. Qualifier.
utter / cause to be heard (shama - from the heavens you uttered judgment)
God's utterance of judgment, ground of the earth's fear
v8 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'From the heavens you UTTERED (shama) judgment' - God's pronouncing of the verdict is not a human IB char; the heavenly sentence the earth fears. Qualifier.
God's verdict, before which the earth is still
v8 QUALIFIER (God's verdict): 'you uttered JUDGMENT (din)' - God's sentence is not a human IB char; the verdict that quiets the earth. Qualifier.
judgment (mishpat - when God arose to judgment)
God's rising to judgment, the saving of the humble
v9 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'when God arose to JUDGMENT (mishpat), to save all the humble' - God's judicial rising is not a human IB char; the act that rescues the meek. Qualifier.
save / deliver (yasha - to save all the humble)
God's saving of the humble of the earth
v9 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'to SAVE (yasha) all the humble of the earth' - God's deliverance is not a human IB char; the rescue of the afflicted (282853). Qualifier.
to be feared / the fear (mora - to him who is to be feared)
God's fearsomeness, which evokes the vows and gifts
v11 QUALIFIER (God's attribute): 'bring gifts to him who is to be FEARED (mora)' - God's fearsomeness is not a human IB char; the awe that draws the tribute (282796). Qualifier.
cut off / curb (batsar - he cuts off the spirit of princes)
God's curbing of the proud spirit of princes
v12 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'he CUTS OFF (batsar) the spirit of princes' - God's severing of proud power is not a human IB char; the humbling of rulers (282801). Qualifier.
to be feared / awesome (yare niphal - he is feared by the kings)
God's fearsomeness before the kings, humbling the princes
v12 QUALIFIER (God's attribute): 'he is FEARED (nora) by the kings of the earth' - God's awesomeness is not a human IB char; the terror that curbs the mighty. Qualifier.
dwelling place / lair (meonah - his abode in Salem)
v2: 'His abode has been established in Salem, his DWELLING PLACE (meonah) in Zion' - God's dwelling in Zion; the place image. Standalone (place).
v3: 'there he broke the FLASHING (resheph) arrows' - the fiery bolts of war God shattered; weapon image. Standalone.
bow / arrows (qeshet - the flashing arrows of the bow)
v3: 'the flashing ARROWS (qeshet, bow)' - the bow God broke; weapon image. Standalone.
v3: 'the shield, the SWORD (chereb)' - the weapon God shattered; war image. Standalone.
war / battle (milchamah - and the weapons of war)
v3: 'and the WAR (milchamah)' - the whole apparatus of battle God broke; war image. Standalone.
prey / mountains of prey (teref - the mountains of prey)
v4: 'more majestic than the mountains of PREY (teref)' - the plunder-heaped hills of the conquerors, over which God is glorious; image. Standalone.
be spoiled / plundered (shalal - the stouthearted were stripped)
v5: 'The stouthearted were SPOILED (shalal); they sank into sleep' - the enemy warriors plundered; image of defeat. Standalone.
sink / slumber (num - they sank into sleep)
v5: 'they SANK (num) into sleep' - the enemy fallen into the sleep of death; image. Standalone.
v5: 'they sank into their SLEEP (shenah)' - the death-sleep of the warriors; image. Standalone.
men of war / valiant (chayil - the men of war)
v5: 'all the men of WAR (chayil) were unable to use their hands' - the enemy valiant made helpless; image of the routed foe. Standalone.
lie stunned / cast into deep sleep (radam - rider and horse lay stunned)
v6: 'both rider and horse LAY STUNNED (radam)' - the enemy felled into a stupor at God's rebuke; image. Standalone.
stand (amad - who can stand before you)
v7: 'who can STAND (amad) before you when once your anger is roused?' - the rhetorical impossibility of withstanding God's wrath; the standing-before-God motif, God-centred here. Standalone.
remnant / remainder (sheerith - the remnant of wrath)
v10: 'the REMNANT (sheerith) of wrath you will put on' - the residue of human fury God restrains/girds; image of the leftover rage God curbs. Standalone.
v10: 'the remnant of WRATH (chemah) you will gird on' - the residual human fury God restrains after the rest is made to praise him (the char, 282784). Standalone (the curbed residue).
gird / put on as a belt (chagar - you will gird on)
v10: 'the remnant of wrath you will GIRD ON (chagar)' - God binding on the leftover wrath like a belt, mastering it; image of restraint. Standalone.
gifts / tribute (shay - let all bring gifts)
v11: 'let all around him bring GIFTS (shay)' - the tribute the peoples present to the awesome God; the object of the bringing (the char, 282796). Standalone (image of homage).
princes / leaders (nagid - the spirit of princes)
v12: 'he cuts off the spirit of PRINCES (nagid)' - the rulers whose proud spirit God curbs (the char spirit, 282801); the bearers of the humbled pride. Standalone (the princes).
